info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Ecommerce Cart Taxs-v2-spec
info.description: The List Cart Tax API provides a comprehensive overview of the applicable taxes associated with items in an eCommerce shopping cart. This endpoint serves as a resource for developers looking to dynamically retrieve current tax rates based on the contents of a user's cart. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure compliance and transparency in tax calculation, improving the customer experience. Typical consumers of this API include eCommerce platforms and developers integrating tax functionalities into online checkout processes.

get.summary: Retrieve tax details for the current cart.
get.description: This endpoint retrieves the tax information applicable to the items in the user's current cart. It provides insights into the total tax amount that will be applied at checkout, facilitating better customer understanding and preparation.

requestBody.description: Requests the tax details for the items in the shopping cart. This body should include necessary parameters to calculate the tax that would apply based on the cart's contents.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content.
